calendar_feed.title: Subscribe to calendar
calendar_feed.project_description: Show this project's work items with a start or due date, its cycles and modules in Outlook, Teams or any other calendar app.
calendar_feed.profile_description: Show the work items assigned to you in a workspace in Outlook, Teams or any other calendar app.
calendar_feed.privacy_note: The calendar only contains title, ID, dates, status and a link – no descriptions, comments or people. Anyone who knows the address can read the calendar, so treat it like a password.
calendar_feed.hide_completed: Hide completed and cancelled work items

created.title: Calendar link created
created.description: Copy the address now. For security reasons it is shown only once.

instructions.title: How to subscribe in Outlook
instructions.step_1: Outlook on the web or new Outlook: open Calendar → Add calendar → Subscribe from web.
instructions.step_2: Paste the address, choose a name and colour, then click Import.
instructions.step_3: Teams uses your Outlook calendar, so the entries show up there as well.
instructions.delay: Outlook refreshes subscribed calendars only every few hours. Changes in Plane can take a while to appear.
